title: Separator
description: A thin divider between groups of content: horizontal, vertical, or with a short label in the middle (“hoặc”).
when: Split groups inside a card or menu; “hoặc” between two ways to sign in.
A vertical rule between toolbar groups.

instead.use: a gap (space-y-*) — most layouts need no line

a11y: Decorative by default (hidden from screen readers); decorative={false} announces a separator.
